field_coverage.organizer_links: No market-organizer/contact columns; 45 eligible sito_web_bando values are stall-allocation notice links, not current event dates or organizer evidence.

proven_gaps: 171 source rows contain dal/al; 14 are non-full-year or ambiguous boundaries. Three exact catalog records contain 38 forecasts outside the explicit single source boundary; one further record has an ambiguous combined al value and 17 forecasts.

formats.actual_layout: CKAN-style source landing page with CSV, JSON and GeoJSON distributions; ArcGIS polygon layer; 10-page municipal table PDF.

field_coverage.address: 2024 CSV/JSON have no street column. The PDF has road type, road name and stretch/subarea, often in merged cells. 75 catalog addresses already come from reviewed PDF extracts; 10 are blank.
field_coverage.hours: 2024 strings read for all 85 records. The 2026 PDF additionally has separate daylight/standard-time columns, per-street variation and evacuation times. Four primary rows differ between seasonal columns; Papiniano has further subarea differences.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Daily flags and day abbreviation are read. Complete PDF has 93 market/weekday pairs, 84 name labels; earlier extract has 87 pairs, 80 labels. Ciccotti contains a construction-related note attached to one street segment.
field_coverage.coordinates: 2024 JSON/CSV contain point coordinates; GeoJSON has 85 MultiPolygons. ArcGIS has 84 polygons and 41 fields. Missing one GIS feature is not proof of one closed market. Polygon footprints are not entrance points.
field_coverage.update: 2024 source content date remains 2024-05-27; the page metadata edit 2026-05-08 is separate. PDF source date 2026-10-01; GIS per-record update remains unknown.
field_coverage.organizer_links: No dedicated organizer/contact field. GIS MAPPA is blank; eight old JSON notes exist, including relocation/history notes and per-day stall counts.

proven_gaps: Six PDF rows absent from prior partial extraction: De Predis Monday, Trechi Monday, Mompiani Tuesday, Segneri Thursday, Delle Betulle (Olmi) Saturday, Osoppo Saturday. Five match existing name/ID mappings; Olmi needs an explicit alias review. Complete venue/day reconciliation is still required; no direct catalog edits follow from this report.
Seasonal, per-street hours and street stretch columns are not consumed by the operational overlays; they only reuse reviewed names/days and a 75-entry street manifest.
The JSON and CSV differ in one MERCATO label (ID39: Fauch / Fauchè); stable ID and the other name field are retained. GeoJSON provides additional polygon geometry, not new street text.

formats.actual_layout: Four municipal tourism detail HTML pages + one GeoJSON layer, equivalent CSV, lossy shapefile ZIP, dataset HTML and metadata ZIP containing ISO XML.

field_coverage.address: All four original addresses are preserved by adapter and catalog.
field_coverage.hours: GeoJSON and CSV have identical full orari strings. HTML also shows these hours and closures. The adapter truncates before the exporter applies another 180-character maximum.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Specific weekly patterns, different floors in Mercato Centrale, recurring holiday closures and dated 2025 closures are present. The generic recurrence label does not expose those distinctions.
field_coverage.coordinates: Four source points, identical across CSV lon/lat and GeoJSON; retained. The shapefile is the same four-market layer, not four additional markets.
field_coverage.update: Dataset page explicitly labels latest data modification as 2026-09-01; XML metadata dateStamp and temporal extent also reference 2026-09-01. Adapter hardcodes 2023-03-03. The 2025 exception dates remain historical facts even with newer dataset metadata.
field_coverage.organizer_links: link has three operator links across two rows, email and phone are populated in one row. These are not mapped by source_firenze or exporter; publisher identity and organizer identity must remain distinct.

proven_gaps: Mercatino di San Lorenzo source hours are 1885 characters after strip; adapter keeps 180, current catalog 160 after final strip. Fifteen of the seventeen explicit date tokens disappear. This is one record with lost constraints, not fifteen missing confirmed 2026 events.
Shapefile DBF truncates three descriptions and one hours field to fixed widths, changes field names to descrizion/feelfloren, and contains character substitutions. GeoJSON/CSV carry the fuller data.
Three source operator links are absent from mapped/public source-link fields.

formats.actual_layout: Opendatasoft source HTML + data metadata JSON + full v1 record JSON; configured generic query projects only six business fields plus record ID.

field_coverage.address: All 39 exact catalog record IDs have source addresses retained. Full specialized adapter excludes fairs/stalls and yields 48 eligible market rows, one with a held temporary address.
field_coverage.hours: All 39 matching originals have hours. Nine have seasonal strings; specialized adapter preserves their text but current generic extractor only accepts one HH:MM-HH:MM pair and returns blank.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Full source has weekday lists, monthly ordinals, split month ranges and July/August exclusion. Current generic candidate does not preserve full source calendar text when it cannot forecast.
field_coverage.coordinates: Source geopoint/lat/long exist for all 39 matches; current generic profile deliberately leaves coordinates unavailable and navigation held. That omission is an explicit policy, not proof of an extraction bug.
field_coverage.update: data_processed 2025-04-02; modified 2025-12-31; metadata_processed 2026-09-30. Only data_processed is used by operational reader for content age. Record_timestamp is retained in original response but not public records.
field_coverage.organizer_links: No event organizer/link field observed. Dataset office contact is metadata, not market organizer. specializzazione is populated on 31 matching rows but excluded by the reduced query.

proven_gaps: Nine source-present/catalog-missing hours proven by recordid and reproduced with current generic candidate; all nine strings have separate seasonal hours.
The generic path does not preserve original days text on the 39 matching records, though it conservatively creates no forecasts from this aged source.
Twelve matching catalog records have category misto although full source specialization permits a more specific reviewed category; includes one vintage and two antiquarian examples.

formats.actual_layout: Municipal attribution HTML + UTF-8 semicolon CSV, four market rows and eleven columns.

field_coverage.address: Road type, road name and hamlet preserved. Two exact catalog IDs have no missing adapter-available fields.
field_coverage.hours: Both endpoints read and checked in all four source rows; 07:30–14:00.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Full weekday present and read; source declares no month/closure columns.
field_coverage.coordinates: Mislabelled long/lat columns are checked against geopoint by the specialized reader. Generic profile intentionally ignores those coordinates.
field_coverage.update: No row update column. Adapter uses national catalog declaration 2026-01-07. Municipal page says 2026-07-27; it does not prove a new per-market update.
field_coverage.organizer_links: No row organizer, phone, email or extra link columns.

scope_notes: All eleven observed columns are consumed by the specialized adapter. Two additional source IDs do not mean two missing markets: the saved overlap report holds Corciano and Ellera against catalog identities/ambiguous city-day matches. That report is historical; current raw CSV hash is identical.
Schema is strict, so newly added columns would stop ingestion rather than silently disappear.

formats.actual_layout: CKAN dataset HTML and JSON metadata; eight historic CSV distributions. June 2022 selected by old probes and newest attached August 2023 both read fully.

field_coverage.address: Original separates INDIRIZZO, Civico, Esp_Civico, Altre_indicazioni and CAP. Current catalog generally retains only street label; 22 of 23 nonempty civics among exact-name matches are absent.
field_coverage.hours: Six weekday opening/closing pairs exist for all 70 source rows, plus five hours notes. At least 68 current records match both unique normalized name and base street and have no hours; 69 match unique name.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Weekday-specific hours imply distinct daily schedules; Note_orari limits late opening to some stalls in Parioli. Three Note_mercato cells describe reconstruction/tender status. Those qualifications need preservation.
field_coverage.coordinates: CSV has no coordinates. Sixty-eight catalog records share the same non_verificata city point 41.9,12.5; no precise point should be inferred from this CSV.
field_coverage.update: Latest resource uploaded 2023-09-25, covers August 2023; per-row AGGIORNATO is 2023-04-30 on 62 rows and 2021-12-31 on eight. Current legacy records contain June 2026 timestamps with no documented row source date association.
field_coverage.organizer_links: Dataset includes counts of operators/stalls but no market organizer identities/contact links.

proven_gaps: Source hours absent from at least 68 rigorously name-and-address matched current records; these are historical data and cannot be promoted to fresh 2026 confirmed opening times.
Two catalog records have replacement-character damage, while source decoding as cp1252 recovers Cinecittà and Unità.
Current repository contains metadata/probe readers and curated XIII overlays but no maintained d881 row adapter; old import cause cannot be attributed to code not present.

formats.actual_layout: Seven-page 2026 administrative PDF, related 2025 return-to-site PDF, 2026 relocation notice HTML, twelve-page AMA planning PDF and nine-marker KML linked by the municipal map HTML.

field_coverage.address: PDF pages 2–3 identify four named weekly/saltuary markets and day-specific sites. Existing curated overlay preserves four approved venues; Fogaccia Tuesday is separate and held because of temporary relocation.
field_coverage.hours: No operating-hour table in the 2026 act. KML provides hours for nine markers but has no per-marker timestamp, and its legacy location labels can conflict with newer acts.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Market-day facts are separate from protocol dates, application deadlines and stall assignment rules. Paper document year is not proof every future weekly occurrence will happen.
field_coverage.coordinates: KML contains nine map markers, neither exact surveyed entrances nor reconciled 2026 sites. The five XIII catalog cards appropriately retain navigation holds.
field_coverage.update: 2026 act dated 2026-03-31; 2025 Ormea return act dated 2025-02-24. AMA 2024–25 attachment includes older data. Map announcement dated 2024-12-16; no marker edit timestamps found.
field_coverage.organizer_links: Municipio administrative responsibility is known; names of officers/vendors in procedure text are not market organizer fields to auto-import.

proven_gaps: Operational source is a fixed reviewed manifest, not a general recurring reader for new versions of the PDF/KML. Row descriptions/stall counts and hours in KML are richer than the curated identity subset but need chronology and site reconciliation.

formats.actual_layout: Municipal notice page with multiple dated procedural updates and attached PDFs; one San Silverio catalog record.

field_coverage.address: Notice establishes San Silverio plateatico identity; old AMA attachment describes temporary Largo Micara, while newer curated source says Via di San Silverio.
field_coverage.hours: No complete current operating schedule established by the notice body. Nine-marker KML includes San Silverio hours but marker age and site reconciliation remain unresolved.
field_coverage.days_months_closures: Notice publication, application windows and market opening schedule are distinct. Existing record correctly has no inferred weekly schedule.
field_coverage.coordinates: No navigation point established by the notice; current hold is consistent with source limitation.
field_coverage.update: Latest visible notice update 2025-09-24; source content age is retained, reading in 2026 does not renew it.
field_coverage.organizer_links: Several attachments are procedure forms/CVs, not market facts. Attachment links inventoried but not all unrelated forms downloaded.

proven_gaps: No maintained extraction path for future notice revisions. Site plan and underlying notice attachments remain a specific follow-up before deriving an entrance or opening schedule.

todos.action: Preserve full source opening/closure text before display truncation; normalize layout whitespace without deleting dates, floor distinctions, month scopes or holiday clauses.
todos.acceptance: Replay the complete four-row original: all 17 date tokens remain attributable in San Lorenzo; source age, IDs, forecast dates and confirmation status unchanged. A long compound hours rule survives adapter and export.

todos.action: Preserve unambiguous source text for seasonal/compound hours even when no single numeric opening pair can be parsed.
todos.acceptance: All nine recordid-matched seasonal strings survive candidate + export; numeric forecasts are not added; source remains 2025-04-02; simple ranges still work.

todos.action: Carry and reconcile dal/al, complete month list, frequency and raw denomination before forecasting; conflicting or malformed boundaries must hold, not be silently ignored.
todos.acceptance: Real 3-record/38-date conflict set is recognized; full-year ranges remain unchanged; Idro combined al is reported as ambiguous. No manual ID exceptions.

todos.action: Preserve source denomination and scope qualifiers beyond transient normalization, distinct from generated display name and navigation address.
todos.acceptance: Roundtrip meaningful source values through a bounded evidence representation; do not substitute tender dates for market dates or tender links for organizers.

todos.action: Parse complete multirow/multicolumn tables and compare full market/day coverage; replace dependence on incomplete 87-row observations with reviewable completeness evidence.
todos.acceptance: Current original yields 93 market/day pairs and 84 labels; six omissions explained; site/day aliases reviewed without collapsing distinct market days/venues.

todos.action: Represent daylight/standard time and street-specific hours separately; distinguish sale closing from sgombero and retain construction qualifications.
todos.acceptance: Ciccotti/Fauchè/Garigliano/Tabacchi seasonal columns and Papiniano split subareas survive; no single time is guessed or blindly copied over a conflicting stored value.

todos.action: Retain polygon geometry as source footprint evidence and relevant relocation notes; preserve per-field source dates when applying newer day/address evidence.
todos.acceptance: Do not convert polygons or old center points into verified entrances; JSON/CSV label variation does not produce new identity.

todos.action: Replace fixed source-date constant with validated metadata evidence scoped to dataset; preserve dated legacy calendar exceptions at their own year.
todos.acceptance: Dataset page data-modified 2026-09-01 is distinguished from per-market verification and from explicit 2025 closures.

todos.scope: Equivalent format selection and operator links
todos.action: Prefer complete GeoJSON/CSV over lossy DBF; retain source-declared business website links and optional contacts separately from publisher attribution.
todos.acceptance: Four records remain four; DBF truncation does not overwrite fuller evidence; three source links remain attributable without inferring organizer authority.

todos.action: Store full original days/months/exclusion string even when too old or too complex for forecast projection.
todos.acceptance: Split months and July/August exclusions remain visible evidence; aged dataset never creates fresh events.

todos.action: Include specialization in the read-only evidence contract and evaluate category mapping instead of dropping the column before parse.
todos.acceptance: Twelve category differences reviewed, including vintage and antiquarian examples; postal/locality metadata and office contact are not mistaken for organizer fields.

todos.action: Keep complete-column parity and inverted-coordinate regression; resolve existing cross-source overlaps only with compatible venue evidence.
todos.acceptance: All eleven original columns remain consumed; no duplicate market created from the two quarantined source IDs; no row freshness manufactured from page timestamp.

todos.action: Build a repeatable reader for the existing d881 resource family with correct decoding, stable identity, civic/subaddress, per-day hours and notes; select latest attached distribution with row dates.
todos.acceptance: 70 named rows, 933 empty rows ignored; damaged UTF-8 replacement values are never emitted; historical row age remains explicit and unknown freshness does not become 2026 confirmation.

todos.action: Reconcile legacy import timestamps against documented row AGGIORNATO and identify repeated city placeholder points separately from real source coordinates.
todos.acceptance: Do not state CSV supplied GPS; preserve source-backed full addresses while withholding unsupported navigation precision.

todos.action: Track revision-aware venue/day evidence across existing notice, acts and map, preserving historical relocation/conflict notes; review relevant notice/site-plan attachments before any entrance or hour claim.
todos.acceptance: Market vs stall vs map marker remains distinct; 2024/2025 map facts cannot overwrite newer 2026 source; no new calendar dates from administrative deadlines.
